summary: The parent returned sqrt(Hamming distance); the fix normalizes binary-quantized distances by dividing by the dimension count. Removing the added override restores the parent's normalization behavior. The imported OR-versus-XOR self-distance description does not match history: both revisions compute built distances using XOR. Blocked: no detecting upstream test exists at this revision. The fix changes no tests; tests::binary_quantized::write_and_retrieve_binary_quantized_vector checks storage and index snapshots without querying distances, and the remaining binary-quantization tests exercise encoding only.
